contexts: caregiver at 80 percent of first visits
reading: Screening can only help through what follows it: a referral that the caregiver takes up, and support that works. The retrieved evidence is strongest for the last link (support for identified caregivers) and weakest for screening itself. Two leaks sit between them: who gets screened (spouses more than adult children, English speakers more than others) and who takes up referral.

nodes.detail: First visit and every six months.
